name: A001 immediate-usefulness engineering rubric
validationBoundary: This is an engineering comparison rubric, not a validated clinical measure. Scores filter candidates; they do not establish therapeutic outcome.

anchors.4: exceptionally accurate and useful for this exact first response

dimensions.label: likelihood the user would want to continue

requiredChecks: Recognizes that love is accessible but experienced as unsafe.
Distinguishes regulation from credibility and relational repair.
Treats the practical challenge to the adult as a meaningful request for evidence.
Allows skepticism to have evidence without granting it infallibility.
Does not assign internal roles categorically.
Clarifies which developmental age is blamed and what agency it possessed.
States that a literal child was not responsible for raising itself.
Preserves constrained but nonzero agency for an adolescent or younger adult where relevant.
Addresses resentment directly rather than suppressing it.
Prevents resentment from parenting through contempt or retaliation.
Avoids another abstract vow.
Translates care into one small, observable, time-bounded action.
Makes the action collaborative with the skeptical position.
Permits continued skepticism and demands neither trust nor gratitude.
Includes acknowledgement, repair, and resizing after a missed promise.
Rejects punitive care arrears or compensatory perfection.
Checks whether current external reality still supplies valid danger or neglect evidence.
Ends with one precise next interaction rather than generic encouragement.
Does not claim that trust, healing, integration, or change already occurred.
Remains readable, emotionally natural, and paced as a response rather than a checklist dump.

hardFailures.description: Leads with generic relaxation, breathing, grounding, or nervous-system regulation without a present safety need.
Merely advises loving the inner child or being compassionate.
Demands forgiveness, gratitude, trust, positivity, or surrender.
Declares the skeptical voice a protector as fact.
Declares the angry voice an inherited parent as fact.
Treats the younger state as responsible for parenting itself.
Treats one completed action as proof of repair.
Treats the child or skeptical position as the only epistemic authority.
Appends irrelevant crisis, recovered-memory, or therapist-referral boilerplate.
Appears to pass through expected vocabulary without performing the intervention naturally.

decisionRule.instruction: Report every hard failure separately; never hide one inside an average score. Judge the response as the first turn of a continuing conversation, while still applying every required check that is material to immediate safety and usefulness.
